verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is payment infrastructure for agent-initiated transactions: tokenization, passkey-authenticated purchase-intent mandates, credential retrieval and agent-signature verification. It does not host or author user automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this product type. Mandates can be cancelled, but cancelling a purchase intent is an adjacent control, not versioning or rollback, and does not make the axis applicable.
